name: whatsapp-backfill
description: Single-source WhatsApp universe (#586) for the gateway-level wraps-real E2E. The fake-corpus seals COMPLETE on a shallow recent-window slice; a later backfill streams the older messages so the affected day-docs DEEPEN in place — the test asserts links survive the deepening, deep-history search finds the backfilled messages, and re-embed is O(1) (only the changed day-docs re-embed).
